name: @w6w-apps/cal
description: Read and manage Cal.com bookings, event types and schedules — the open-source scheduling platform.

w6w.longDescription:
Cal.com is an open-source scheduling platform, and this app puts its bookings, event types and schedules into a workflow: list, fetch, create, cancel and reschedule bookings by their own id, and read the event types and schedules configured on the account.

Cal.com's newer API versions each endpoint group independently rather than the whole API at once, so a workflow calling through this app is automatically talking to the version each action was built and verified against — one less thing to track when Cal.com ships a change underneath. Creating a booking takes a structured location object — an attendee address, a video integration, and so on — rather than a bare string, matching what the vendor's API actually expects.

Authentication is a single per-account API key. Cal.com's own "Platform OAuth" path for public integrators is closed to new signups, so a direct key is the one route open today, and cancelling or rescheduling always works against a booking's own id rather than a guess at which one is meant.
